previous_statement: The map v^+ is dagger-preserving and its unit defect at every amplification is at most C_u(d^2+epsilon), for a universal C_u, once d+epsilon is below a universal positive threshold.
new_statement: The defining dagger condition for an extended d-inclusion makes v dagger-preserving, and w_doubleprime(X)=w_prime(X^dagger)^dagger makes w=(w_prime+w_doubleprime)/2 dagger-preserving, so v^+=v+w is dagger-preserving. Put mu=105(d^2+epsilon), x=v^+(I_B), and y=x-I_A. From ||v^+-v||<=2d and the d-unit bound for v, ||y||<=3d. Multiplicativity gives ||x^2-x||<=mu. Expanding x=I_A+y and using the approximate-unit and product inequalities gives ||y||<=mu+epsilon(1+epsilon)+2epsilon||y||+(1+epsilon)||y||^2. If d+epsilon<=1/16, then ||y||<=3/16 and the last two terms are absorbed, yielding ||y||<=4(mu+epsilon)<=424(d^2+epsilon). The unit of M_n tensor B maps to I_n tensor x, and the operator-space axioms give ||I_n tensor y||=||y||; hence every amplification has unit defect at most C_u(d^2+epsilon) with C_u=424.
